description.value:
Bark and branch structure has grown through one forearm, and set.

Gift — The arm is a shield: once per day, Raise a Shield as a free action with Hardness 5. Tithe — It occupies both the Arm and Dermal slots on that side, and it doesn't bend the way an arm should: permanent −1 circumstance to two-handed weapon attacks and to Athletics to Swim.

cinderfall.incomplete: Raising the arm as a shield (Hardness 5, usable once per day as a free action) has no rule-element equivalent: granting a shield-block reaction requires a real Shield-type item plus a frequency-tracked granted action (GrantItem), not a single rule element on this equipment card -- the same class of gap as the missile/mortar ammo cards flagged in the equipment pass (out of scope for a rule-element-only pass). The two-handed-attack and Swim penalties are real modifiers and are automated below.
